plotEn: The Severson family move into a suburban North Carolina neighborhood and soon becomes unsettled by their next-door neighbors the Kringles, who celebrate Christmas throughout the year. As their young son grows increasingly drawn to the neighboring household, the parents grow suspicious. When Mark Severson confronts the situation, he learns that the neighbors are part of a dangerous cult with plans to force the family into their way of life. He is forced to join forces with a rogue alcoholic Mall Santa in order to free his family.
